action_args.justification: The series is seasonally dominated (strength 0.65, period 52) with moderate trend and ~3% outliers. These characteristics favour a robust combination (trimmed mean) over a moderate pool (7 models) that captures the top performers without overfitting to any single window. The leader (trimmed_mean pool2, trim=0.2) is a seeded baseline and the runner-up is not statistically distinguishable, so accepting is the correct call.
